title.narrative: ISEM II Multi Annual Programme Estimate

description.narrative: The MAPE aims to support the delivery of ISEM II programme objects in the areas of access, qualty and management of secondary education in Malawi. Specifically, activities under the MAPE will cover results; 2.2 on continuous professional development, 2.3 teacher training, 2.4 roll out of the curriculum 2.5 English language and 3.1. governance and management of the sector, and 3.2 and 3.3 decentralization.
